## History

Carlo was a dog owned by [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) for about a year prior to Rufus's marriage to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). When Rufus set sail on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), he entrusted Carlo to Lorna's care. Carlo later died, leaving [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to mourn her loyal pet.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035)_
